metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.3 · 1980 · Prom Night
metas.description: At a high-school senior prom, a masked killer stalks four teenagers who were responsible for the accidental death of a classmate six years previously.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.8 · 1987 · Hello Mary Lou: Prom Night II
metas.description: Thirty years after her accidental death at her 1957 senior prom, the tortured spirit of prom queen Mary Lou Maloney returns to seek revenge.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.7 · 1990 · Prom Night III: The Last Kiss
metas.description: The malevolent spirit of Mary Lou Maloney returns to Hamilton High, where she manipulates a naive male student into helping her wreak havoc on the school.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.1 · 1991 · Prom Night IV: Deliver Us from Evil
metas.description: Four students ditch their high school prom for a party at a summer home, unaware that a psychotic priest is on the loose, determined to punish sinners.
